name: parallelism-test-f4e9b129d1/parallelism-v.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: supported statement list includes While and Foreach, but does not include fork statements or named worker declarations.
reason: The asserted sorted output depends on recursive fork blocks containing named workers w1 and w2, whose completion is awaited before merging. Fork statements and named worker declarations are not covered by the supported positive lists. Explicit support for start and wait actions covers the ordering test but does not establish support for the worker/fork construct essential to the merge-sort test.
unsupported_constructs: fork blocks with named worker declarations
test_design_notes: The ordering assertion waits for the child before appending the parent entry; its busy loop does not independently prove parallel execution.
io:println is output instrumentation only; array.length() is explicitly supported.
